naea647148b.headline: Government approves R51 billion guarantee facility for Transnet
naea647148b.summary: Transport Minister Barbara Creecy has approved a R51 billion guarantee facility for Transnet, with the concurrence of the Finance Minister. The approval was announced this week.
naea647148b.why: Transnet is South Africa's state-owned rail and port operator, and government guarantees affect its borrowing costs and the public finances.

ncf387b2f92.headline: Ukraine's NovaPay led in transactions in 2024, while privatmoney topped in transfer volumes
ncf387b2f92.summary: The number of money transfers through payment systems in Ukraine rose 28.5% in 2024, to nearly 1.1 billion transactions. NovaPay led in transaction count and privatmoney topped transfer volumes.
ncf387b2f92.why: Payment system activity is a gauge of consumer spending and digital finance adoption, which matter for banks and fintech firms.

n0fad9372d6.headline: WTI Settles at $61.53 in Light Trade
n0fad9372d6.summary: Oil prices rose slightly in light trade as hopes for a nuclear deal faded. Stronger U.S. data also boosted the demand outlook.
n0fad9372d6.why: West Texas Intermediate is a benchmark U.S. crude grade, and its price feeds into fuel costs and energy-sector earnings worldwide.

nbd1b5fe3be.headline: Sri Lanka rupee closes stronger, bond yields down
nbd1b5fe3be.summary: The Sri Lankan rupee closed at 299.440/45 to the US dollar in the spot market on Friday, stronger than Thursday's close. Bond yields were also down, dealers said.
nbd1b5fe3be.why: The rupee's exchange rate and local bond yields shape import costs and borrowing conditions in Sri Lanka's economy.

n9401aa8e5e.headline: African Review - Energy - 120MW Mozambique transmission project funding
n9401aa8e5e.summary: A 120MW transmission project in Mozambique has secured funding, according to African Review. The report gives no further financial details.
n9401aa8e5e.why: Transmission lines connect power generation to consumers and are a key part of energy infrastructure investment. Funding determines whether such projects proceed.

neda11bc189.headline: Increasing Domestic Gas and Oil Extraction Strengthens Energy Sovereignty
neda11bc189.summary: More gas and oil was recovered from Hungarian fields between January and March than in the same period of 2024, the energy ministry and regulator said jointly.
neda11bc189.why: Domestic hydrocarbon output reduces Hungary's reliance on imported energy, which affects its trade balance and exposure to global energy prices.

n94f5249b96.headline: Iran-US talks made ‘some but not conclusive progress,’ mediator Oman says - The Boston Globe
n94f5249b96.summary: Mediator Oman said the Iran-US talks made some but not conclusive progress. The remarks suggest the negotiations between the two longtime enemies will continue.
n94f5249b96.why: Negotiations between Iran and the United States affect oil supply expectations and sanctions risk, which feed directly into global energy prices.

n01ac279ea8.headline: Trump Threatens 50% Tariffs on Europe – Markets React in Shock
n01ac279ea8.summary: The US president escalated his trade war with Europe on Friday by threatening to increase tariffs on the European Union from 30% to 50%. Markets reacted sharply.
n01ac279ea8.why: The European Union is one of the largest trading partners of the United States, so higher tariffs would affect exporters, supply chains and European equity indices.
n01ac279ea8.why_moved: The input describes a threatened increase in US tariffs on the EU from 30% to 50%, which markets reacted to sharply.

n307e9a610a.headline: Energy Price Cap: Ofgem drops cap by £129 from July
n307e9a610a.summary: Ofgem announced a decrease of £129 to the energy price cap from July, though prices remain 65 per cent higher than five years ago.
n307e9a610a.why: Ofgem is the UK energy regulator, and the price cap sets the maximum unit rates suppliers can charge households, affecting inflation and consumer spending.

nc102d339f1.headline: Sale of Société Générale: We're waiting on the parties to reach an agreement - BoG Governor
nc102d339f1.summary: Bank of Ghana Governor Johnson Asiama said the central bank is waiting for the parties involved in the acquisition of shares in Société Générale to reach an agreement. The central bank is not a party to the sale.
nc102d339f1.why: Société Générale is a major French bank with African operations, and changes to its subsidiary holdings affect its regional franchise and capital allocation.

naa1074dfa8.headline: CBN adjusts rates to buy, sell dollar as naira records highest gain in 30 days
naa1074dfa8.summary: The naira recorded its highest gain in 30 days, appreciating to N1,579 per dollar from N1,583.92 the previous day at the NFEM window. The CBN adjusted its rates to buy and sell dollars.
naa1074dfa8.why: The Central Bank of Nigeria manages the naira and foreign exchange market, and its rate moves affect importers, inflation and foreign investors.

n2fd8b3d68e.headline: Trump targets illegal migration with remittance tax plan
n2fd8b3d68e.summary: Washington plans a 5% tax on remittance transfers that would cover millions of foreigners living in the US. About $160 billion is sent by Latin Americans alone, so their home countries would be among the hardest hit.
n2fd8b3d68e.why: Remittances are a major source of foreign income for many emerging economies, so a transfer tax can affect household spending and national balance of payments.

nd13bbbe518.headline: Ukraine Calls on Europe to Help Finance Ukraine’s Military, Invest in Security Against Russia
nd13bbbe518.summary: Ukraine's finance minister proposed integrating Ukraine's military potential into the European security system. The move could ease Kyiv's 2026 financial burden as the war continues.
nd13bbbe518.why: Ukraine's external financing needs depend on Western funding, which shapes its public finances and the broader European defence and reconstruction outlook.

nf96733d172.headline: India’s GDP growth projected at 6.8 pc in Q4, overall consumption healthy
nf96733d172.summary: A new report projects India's Q4 GDP growth at 6.8% and full-year FY25 growth at 6.3%. The report cites strength in agriculture, hotels, transport and construction.
nf96733d172.why: India's GDP growth is a key indicator for the world's fastest-growing large economy, influencing equity markets, the rupee and central bank policy.

n00929321f9.headline: Miniștrii de Finanțe din G7, de acord să preseze suplimentar Rusia dacă nu acceptă o încetare a focului în Ucraina
n00929321f9.summary: G7 finance ministers and central bank governors meeting in western Canada agreed Russia could face further sanctions if it resists a Ukraine ceasefire.
n00929321f9.why: The G7 coordinates sanctions on Russia, which affect energy flows, commodity markets and sanctioned company exposures. Its finance ministers set joint economic policy among the largest advanced economies.

nb1b6d0f73f.headline: Retail sales jump in April as sunny weather boosts food shopping
nb1b6d0f73f.summary: The Office for National Statistics said overall UK retail sales volumes rose by 1.2% in April. Sunny weather boosted food shopping, according to the report.
nb1b6d0f73f.why: Retail sales data is a key gauge of consumer spending, which drives a large share of UK economic output and informs Bank of England policy expectations.

n1ab545f1b8.headline: Prime Minister: “Energy policy is designed to hurt Russia, not to help Europeans”
n1ab545f1b8.summary: In a Kossuth Radio interview, Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán said EU energy policy aims to hurt Russia. He also said EU states would rather help Ukraine than their own families.
n1ab545f1b8.why: Hungary relies heavily on Russian energy imports, so its stance on EU energy sanctions and policy affects its energy costs and budget.

n8c6c5256e8.headline: Fan fury as viral Labubu dolls pulled from UK stores over
n8c6c5256e8.summary: Maker Pop Mart has paused sales of its Labubu dolls in UK stores after reports of customers fighting over them. Fans reacted angrily online to the decision.
n8c6c5256e8.why: Pop Mart is a Chinese designer toy company whose collectible blind-box products have driven strong sales growth in recent years.

n5153acc6e1.headline: Brazilian meat giant JBS clears path for US listing with Dutch-based holding structure - Invezz
n5153acc6e1.summary: Brazilian meat producer JBS has set up a Dutch-based holding structure that clears the path for a US listing, according to Invezz.
n5153acc6e1.why: JBS is one of the world's largest beef and poultry processors, and a US listing would give it access to American capital markets.

ne608b166e3.headline: Rupee soars with Asian peers to post best day in over two years
ne608b166e3.summary: The Indian rupee rose sharply on Friday to post its best single-day gain in more than two years. The move came alongside Asian peers amid worries over U.S. fiscal health.
ne608b166e3.why: The rupee is India's currency, and its moves affect importers, foreign portfolio flows and inflation expectations in Asia's large emerging economies.

impacts.name: Indian rupee
impacts.why: The rupee posted its best single-day gain in over two years.

ne608b166e3.why_moved: The rupee rallied alongside Asian peers as worries over U.S. fiscal health weighed on the dollar.

n2f82481c5e.headline: Fidelis aims to upsize Herbie Re 2025-1 aggregate retro cat bond to $90m - Artemis.bm
n2f82481c5e.summary: Fidelis Insurance raised the target size of its Herbie Re 2025-1 catastrophe bond to provide $90 million of worldwide aggregate retrocession cover.
n2f82481c5e.why: Catastrophe bonds transfer insurance risk to capital markets investors, and Fidelis is a Bermuda-based specialty insurer.

n6033b24f4e.headline: Delivery Hero Social Plan Accepted by Almost All Couriers
n6033b24f4e.summary: Almost all couriers at the delivery service Lieferando have accepted the social plan, after the deadline for agreeing to it passed.
n6033b24f4e.why: Lieferando is part of Delivery Hero, and courier arrangements affect the group's labour costs in Germany.

n9b520dc9d7.headline: Donald Trump calls for more oil drilling in Scottish waters
n9b520dc9d7.summary: US President Donald Trump called for more oil drilling in Scottish waters. He argued that it would reduce energy costs for Scots.
n9b520dc9d7.why: North Sea drilling affects UK oil and gas output and energy prices, and the UK regulates offshore licensing and taxation of the sector.

nc030e25bae.headline: Cheerful mood on the Stockholm Stock Exchange, OMXS30 index rises 0.5 percent
nc030e25bae.summary: The OMXS30 index rose 0.5 percent on the last trading day of the week, after the Stockholm Stock Exchange opened positively and cooled after a few hours.
nc030e25bae.why: The OMXS30 tracks the 30 most traded shares on the Stockholm Stock Exchange and is the main benchmark for Swedish large-cap equities.

impacts.name: OMXS30
impacts.why: The index itself rose 0.5 percent in the session described.

na977c1944c.headline: Wall St falls as Trump tariff threats spark market uncertainty
na977c1944c.summary: US stocks fell on Friday and posted a weekly loss after Trump recommended 50% tariffs on European goods, reopening a new front in global trade tensions.
na977c1944c.why: The S&P 500 is the benchmark for large US companies, which are exposed to global trade flows. Tariff threats on major trading partners can affect corporate earnings and risk sentiment.
na977c1944c.why_moved: Trump's recommendation of 50% tariffs on European goods raised trade-tension concerns, and US stocks fell and posted a weekly loss.

nabaaf56d94.headline: China-linked ‘Silk Typhoon’ hackers accessed Commvault cloud environments, person familiar says
nabaaf56d94.summary: The China-linked hacking group Silk Typhoon accessed Commvault cloud environments, according to a person familiar with the matter. The unit had previously infiltrated US Treasury Department networks.
nabaaf56d94.why: Commvault is a data backup and recovery software provider, so breaches of its cloud systems can affect customers' data security and the company's reputation.

n730aca95e2.headline: May 14-20 US severe weather to cost re/insurers $4bn to $7bn: Bowen, Gallagher Re - Artemis.bm
n730aca95e2.summary: Severe convective storm activity across the United States has cost the insurance and reinsurance industry more than $20 billion in 2025, according to brokers including Gallagher Re. The May 14-20 storms are estimated at $4bn to $7bn in losses.
n730aca95e2.why: Reinsurers take on part of primary insurers' catastrophe losses, so large weather-related claims affect their earnings, capital and pricing of future coverage.

source.name: Artemis.bm - The Catastrophe Bond, Insurance Linked Securities & Investment, Rei

sources.name: Artemis.bm - The Catastrophe Bond, Insurance Linked Securities & Investment, Rei

n443975d3ba.headline: Australia's Luxury Car Tax could be removed gradually – report
n443975d3ba.summary: The Luxury Car Tax could be scrapped gradually as part of trade negotiations with the European Union, according to a report. The item gives no timeline or revenue figures.
n443975d3ba.why: Changes to Australian car taxes affect vehicle import costs, the revenue base of the federal government and the terms of trade with major partners.

n10ec3cfbf1.headline: Quick Takes of the Week to May 30
n10ec3cfbf1.summary: Listed telco infrastructure company Vital extended a trading halt that had been in place since the previous day, following a takeover approach. The company had previously been the subject of takeover interest that was withdrawn last September.
n10ec3cfbf1.why: Trading halts pending takeover announcements are standard on New Zealand's exchange and often precede significant changes in a company's ownership.

source.name: NBR | Business news & analysis | Independent, ad-free reporting

n10708a791e.headline: New Zealand takes scalpel to foreign aid budget
n10708a791e.summary: New Zealand's foreign aid will fall to 0.24 per cent of gross national income, with particular cuts in several areas. The move is part of a budget reduction.
n10708a791e.why: Official development assistance is a budget line set by government, reflecting fiscal priorities rather than market conditions.

n28e8208276.headline: Altisource Shares to Be Consolidated at a Ratio of 1-for-8
n28e8208276.summary: Altisource Portfolio Solutions will consolidate its shares at a ratio of 1-for-8. The action is expected to help the company regain compliance with the Nasdaq minimum bid price requirement.
n28e8208276.why: Altisource is a Luxembourg-registered provider of mortgage and real estate services listed on Nasdaq.

n699b0b64c1.headline: RBNZ Decision, Japan CPI, Fed Minutes, and US Core PCE - Markets Weekly Preview
n699b0b64c1.summary: A weak US dollar is boosting FX, crypto and gold. Key events ahead include the RBNZ rate decision, Japan CPI and US core PCE data due Friday.
n699b0b64c1.why: Central bank decisions and inflation data such as core PCE drive interest rate expectations across global markets.

n129b3a5b38.headline: Ayala eyes health tech growth with BD tie-up
n129b3a5b38.summary: Ayala Healthcare Holdings has entered a five-year partnership with medical technology firm Becton Dickinson to drive healthcare innovation in the Philippines and Southeast Asia.
n129b3a5b38.why: Becton Dickinson is a major US medical technology company supplying hospitals and laboratories worldwide.

nd4d3c58dc5.headline: PSEi rebounds on bargain hunting, foreign inflows
nd4d3c58dc5.summary: The PSEi gained 1.71% as bargain hunters and foreign inflows lifted sentiment. Financials led the gains while analysts urged caution amid global uncertainties.
nd4d3c58dc5.why: The PSEi is the Philippine Stock Exchange benchmark index, and foreign flows are a key driver of its moves.

ne74b8f579d.headline: FBM KLCI snaps six-day losing streak to close higher
ne74b8f579d.summary: The FBM KLCI snapped a six-session losing streak on Friday, closing higher even though regional markets were broadly weaker.
ne74b8f579d.why: The FBM KLCI is Malaysia's benchmark index of the 30 largest companies listed on Bursa Malaysia.

impacts.name: FBM KLCI
impacts.why: The benchmark closed higher after six straight losing sessions.

n8f66805bf4.headline: April inflation remains steady
n8f66805bf4.summary: Malaysia's headline inflation for April 2025 was 1.4%, matching March and slightly below the 1.5% recorded in February.
n8f66805bf4.why: Inflation readings shape the central bank's interest-rate decisions, which affect borrowing costs and the ringgit. Stable consumer prices support household spending.

n523231f97d.headline: Cyprus Business Now: wages, maritime, CSE, BoC, compliance, real estate
n523231f97d.summary: Average monthly earnings in Cyprus rose 5% in the fourth quarter of 2024 from a year earlier and 1.2% from the previous quarter, seasonally adjusted, preliminary data showed.
n523231f97d.why: Wage growth feeds into household spending and inflation, and it matters for labour costs for companies operating in Cyprus. Cystat is the island's official statistics agency.

n7665c77d31.headline: Why Tata Motors is likely to be in the slow lane
n7665c77d31.summary: Tata Motors was the second-biggest loser on the Sensex on Wednesday, closing about 1.3% lower. The decline followed weaker-than-expected March-quarter operational performance and a muted near-term outlook.
n7665c77d31.why: Tata Motors is an Indian automaker with passenger and commercial vehicle businesses and owns Jaguar Land Rover. Its quarterly results and outlook influence Indian auto sector sentiment.

nb188428991.headline: Sri Lanka rupee opens up, bond yields down sharply
nb188428991.summary: Sri Lanka's rupee opened at 299.10/25 to the US dollar on Friday, stronger than Thursday's close of 299.35/45. Bond yields were down sharply, dealers said.
nb188428991.why: The rupee's level against the dollar and government bond yields are key gauges of Sri Lanka's financial conditions and borrowing costs.

nf94c3c4309.headline: Indian equity benchmarks top Asian gainers, erase weekly losses
nf94c3c4309.summary: India's equity benchmarks rose on Friday to outperform major Asian peers as easing US Treasury yields lifted sentiment. The Nifty 50 rose 0.99 percent to 24,853.15.
nf94c3c4309.why: The Nifty 50 is India's leading benchmark index, and Indian equities are closely watched by global investors in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Nifty 50
impacts.why: The index rose 0.99 percent, outpacing other Asian benchmarks.

nf94c3c4309.why_moved: Easing US Treasury yields lifted global investor sentiment, helping Indian benchmarks outperform regional peers and recover the week's losses.

n5043580c6d.headline: EU loan scheme can help Ukraine: commissioner - Taipei Times
n5043580c6d.summary: A 150 billion euro loan programme to rearm Europe, finalised this week, could be a very important breakthrough in EU military support for Ukraine, according to the defence commissioner.
n5043580c6d.why: EU joint borrowing programmes affect European government debt markets and defence industry spending. Defence contractors and sovereign borrowers are the main channels of impact.

nb00d05d4f7.headline: Dollar set to snap 4-week winning streak on US fiscal health worries
nb00d05d4f7.summary: The dollar is set to end a four-week rally after Moody's downgraded US debt ratings last week. Investors are focused on the country's $36 trillion debt pile and a tax bill.
nb00d05d4f7.why: The US dollar is the world's main reserve currency, so shifts in its value affect global capital flows, commodity prices and emerging-market borrowing costs.
nb00d05d4f7.why_moved: Moody's downgrade of US debt ratings has focused investors on the size of US government debt and a pending tax bill, prompting a reassessment of the dollar.

n8fe1081d8d.headline: Japan Rice Crisis: Emergency reserves, high prices, rationing. How did Japan's rice crisis get this far? | World News - Times of India
n8fe1081d8d.summary: Japan is dealing with a rice crisis involving emergency reserves, high prices and rationing. Rice is a staple of Japanese diet and politics.
n8fe1081d8d.why: Rice is a core food staple in Japan, and its price and supply affect household inflation and government political standing.

n8342b83305.headline: Sri Lanka tourist arrivals up 14.43-pct to May 21
n8342b83305.summary: Sri Lanka's tourist arrivals from May 1 to 21 rose 14.43% from a year earlier to 91,785. Most visitors still came from India, according to tourism promotion office data.
n8342b83305.why: Tourism is a significant source of foreign currency earnings for Sri Lanka. Arrival trends are a key indicator of the economy's recovery.

n73d1e58573.headline: Ministry of finance sets june 10 for budget presentation in national assembly
n73d1e58573.summary: Pakistan's federal budget for fiscal 2025-26 will be presented in the National Assembly on June 10. The Economic Survey will be released a day earlier, on June 9.
n73d1e58573.why: The federal budget sets tax and spending policy, which shapes fiscal deficits, bond markets and the outlook for Pakistani companies.

nc1b8d73f8b.headline: NT$ rise impact on Cathay Life limited - Taipei Times
nc1b8d73f8b.summary: Cathay Financial Holding said the local currency's sharp appreciation has limited impact on its life insurance arm. It cited 20 years of foreign exchange risk management and a dynamic hedging strategy.
nc1b8d73f8b.why: Cathay Financial is a major Taiwanese financial holding company whose life insurer holds large foreign-currency assets, making currency moves relevant to its earnings.

impacts.name: Cathay Financial Holding
impacts.why: The company says its hedging limits the effect of the currency's appreciation on its life insurer.

n4c4d5af2ee.headline: Lai calls for chip supply chain unity amid dumping - Taipei Times
n4c4d5af2ee.summary: President William Lai called for unity and cooperation in the global semiconductor supply chain to counter dumping by Chinese suppliers. He spoke at a forum organised by ITRI.
n4c4d5af2ee.why: Taiwan is a leading producer of advanced semiconductors, so trade practices in chip supply chains directly affect global technology companies and their costs.

n2ee6fb9f9c.headline: Bitcoin Dips to $108K as CZ Blasts Wall Street Journal for Slander
n2ee6fb9f9c.summary: Bitcoin fell nearly 3% to about $108,000 on Friday afternoon after touching a record high. The sell-off followed a public attack on the Wall Street Journal by Changpeng Zhao.
n2ee6fb9f9c.why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency by market value, and its price swings affect crypto-linked equities and digital-asset funds. Changpeng Zhao founded Binance, one of the largest crypto exchanges.
n2ee6fb9f9c.why_moved: Bitcoin reversed from a record high and dropped about 3% in the same session, as reported. The input does not give a specific cause beyond the dispute with the Wall Street Journal.

n0a41e982ff.headline: Lai announces NT$10bn fund for green growth - Taipei Times
n0a41e982ff.summary: President William Lai announced a NT$10 billion (US$333 million) green growth fund at the Asia Green Growth Forum in Taipei. It will invest in net zero and sustainability-focused industries.
n0a41e982ff.why: Government-backed funds steer capital into targeted industries, which can shape demand for clean-energy and sustainability companies. Taiwan is a major manufacturing and semiconductor economy.

n363f3cafb4.headline: Hudson’s Bay aims to sell dozens of store leases to B.C. mall owner  | Globalnews.ca
n363f3cafb4.summary: Hudson's Bay plans to sell up to 28 of its store leases to a British Columbia mall owner. The buyer wants to launch a new modern department store.
n363f3cafb4.why: Hudson's Bay is one of Canada's largest department store operators. Lease sales let retailers raise cash and exit underperforming locations.

n67d7c49c4c.headline: Will Gold Break Its All-Time High in 2025? Momentum Builds Ahead of Key Level
n67d7c49c4c.summary: Gold rebounded sharply and is within 3.8% of its all-time high. Safe-haven demand rose as Trump revived tariff talks, according to the report.
n67d7c49c4c.why: Gold is a traditional safe-haven asset that investors often buy during trade tensions and economic uncertainty.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Safe-haven demand rose as tariff talks revived, lifting gold's price toward its record high.

n67d7c49c4c.why_moved: The input links rising safe-haven demand to renewed tariff talks, which supported the rebound in gold.

n8c538ba67c.headline: Statistics Canada reports retail sales up 0.8 per cent in March at $69.8 billion
n8c538ba67c.summary: Retail sales rose 0.8% to $69.8 billion in March. Higher new car sales helped as Canadians bought vehicles before tariffs started to raise prices.
n8c538ba67c.why: Retail sales are a key monthly indicator of consumer spending, which drives a large share of Canada's economy.

nb66ef46c8d.headline: Niagara No-Brainer: Restaino Dunks $1.5B Data Center
nb66ef46c8d.summary: The proposed $1.5 billion data center adjacent to downtown Niagara Falls has been temporarily derailed. The mayor's administration invoked eminent domain over the developer's planned site.
nb66ef46c8d.why: Data centers are large capital projects that depend on power, land and permits, and local government decisions can delay them.

n61dfb3e78f.headline: RBI’s ₹2.68 Lakh Crore Dividend Bonanza Beats Govt Estimate
n61dfb3e78f.summary: India’s central bank transferred a record ₹2.68 lakh crore surplus to the government for FY25, surpassing estimates.
n61dfb3e78f.why: This dividend boost impacts government revenue and signals strong RBI financial performance.

nb410e56216.headline: Internal accruals may fund roughly half of Vedanta’s $20 billion expansion plan: Anil Agarwal
nb410e56216.summary: Vedanta plans a $20 billion expansion, funded through internal earnings, equity, and debt, with an Rs 80,000 crore investment in the North East.
nb410e56216.why: Vedanta's expansion impacts commodity markets and regional economic development in India.

n5699c3e8af.headline: Energy Price Cap: Ofgem drops cap by £129 from July
n5699c3e8af.summary: Ofgem announced a decrease in the UK energy price cap by £129, though prices remain significantly higher than five years ago.
n5699c3e8af.why: Lower energy prices can influence consumer spending, inflation, and household budgets in the UK.

n7969292343.headline: Trump threatens 25% tariff on Apple iPhones, 50% import tax on European Union
n7969292343.summary: President Trump threatened a 25% tariff on Apple iPhones and a 50% import tax on European Union goods, urging Apple to manufacture in the U.S.
n7969292343.why: Tariffs on major trade partners and key companies like Apple can disrupt global supply chains and affect multinational corporate earnings.

impacts.name: Apple
impacts.why: Tariffs increase costs and may reduce Apple's profit margins.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n7969292343.why_moved: The tariff threats raised concerns about escalating trade tensions, impacting Apple’s supply chain and investor sentiment.

n7c4e4822cf.headline: Malaysia, Thailand collaborate to improve river mouth of Sungai Golok
n7c4e4822cf.summary: Malaysia and Thailand undertake a cross-border project to improve the Sungai Golok river mouth to reduce flooding and enhance local living conditions.
n7c4e4822cf.why: Infrastructure projects improve regional economic stability and cross-border cooperation.

n24c4ff8be4.headline: Fidelity Bank denies insider trading allegation against CEO, to seek legal redress
n24c4ff8be4.summary: Fidelity Bank Plc dismissed reports accusing its managing director of insider trading and misuse of bank funds and intends to seek legal redress.
n24c4ff8be4.why: Allegations of insider trading can affect a bank's reputation and investor confidence.

n3df2b324f4.headline: RBI Forex Intervention Hits Highest In 17 Years
n3df2b324f4.summary: The Reserve Bank of India conducted its largest foreign exchange intervention in 17 years in response to market panic triggered by US trade tariff actions.
n3df2b324f4.why: RBI's intervention aims to stabilize the rupee and financial markets amid global trade uncertainties, affecting currency and capital flows.
n3df2b324f4.why_moved: The RBI's large-scale forex intervention was aimed at curbing rupee volatility caused by trade tensions, stabilizing the currency.

n3041006d93.headline: Thailand sees car sales bounce back after nearly 2 years
n3041006d93.summary: Thailand’s domestic car sales increased by 1% year-on-year in April 2025, marking the first growth in nearly two years.
n3041006d93.why: Car sales growth signals improving consumer demand and economic recovery in Thailand’s automotive sector.

nc95f8666c3.headline: South Africa: 289 workers trapped in gold mine, have given signs of life, food is being passed to them
nc95f8666c3.summary: Sibanye Stillwater is running a rescue operation for 289 workers trapped underground at its Kloof gold mine near Johannesburg, with signs of life reported and food passed to them.
nc95f8666c3.why: Sibanye-Stillwater is a major South African gold and platinum producer, so safety incidents at its mines can disrupt output and raise operating costs.

n29861fe48b.headline: Yolanda Díaz criticizes the "tax gifts" in the housing measures proposed by the PSOE: "Justice starts from the top"
n29861fe48b.summary: Second Deputy Prime Minister Yolanda Díaz criticised some housing measures in a Socialist Party bill, including tax breaks for owners who do not raise prices. She said justice must start from the top.
n29861fe48b.why: Housing policy and tax rules influence rental and property markets and the investment case for residential real estate in Spain.

n5cc2c39884.headline: Indonesia State Budget Surplus Rp 4.3 T in April 2025 after 3 Months of Deficit
n5cc2c39884.summary: Indonesia's state budget recorded a surplus of Rp 4.3 trillion through the end of April 2025, after three months of deficit.
n5cc2c39884.why: Budget balances reflect the government's fiscal position, which shapes investor views on Indonesia's sovereign debt and currency.

n017591081a.headline: Metrodata Electronics Distributes Dividend of Rp 294.6 Billion
n017591081a.summary: PT Metrodata Electronics Tbk will distribute a dividend of Rp 24 per share, totalling Rp 294.6 billion. The payout equals 39.8% of fiscal 2024 net profit and is up 14.3% on the previous year.
n017591081a.why: Metrodata Electronics is an Indonesian technology distributor, and its dividend policy is relevant to shareholders in the Jakarta-listed company.

nc5147c9b70.headline: It's happening. New fuel prices from Monday. Two will equalize, the third will get cheaper. This is what we will pay
nc5147c9b70.summary: After a series of declines in gasoline, diesel and LPG autogas prices, forecasts show two fuels will equalise in price while the third gets cheaper from Monday. The changes apply to the last week of May.
nc5147c9b70.why: Retail fuel prices in Poland track wholesale crude and refined product prices, which feed into consumer inflation and transport costs.

n7757def817.headline: Lula argues that Petrobras should resume an active role in oil and gas exploration | Economy
n7757def817.summary: Brazilian President Lula said Petrobras should resume an active role in oil and gas exploration. He spoke after signing acts alongside Angola's president.
n7757def817.why: Petrobras is Brazil's state-controlled oil company, so government views on its exploration strategy shape its investment plans and Brazil's oil output.

n879da7e8b5.headline: Here is the progress of JTrust Bank in pursuing free float
n879da7e8b5.summary: Bank JTrust Indonesia (BCIC) says it is working to meet the 7.5% free float requirement, as its shares have been suspended since the start of 2025.
n879da7e8b5.why: Indonesian listing rules require minimum free float, and trading suspensions limit liquidity and investor access to listed shares.

nd39218dce2.headline: BRI provides Rp700 billion in "cash loan" and "non-cash loan" to PELNI
nd39218dce2.summary: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (BRI) provided cash loan and non-cash loan facilities worth Rp700 billion to PT Pelayaran Nasional Indonesia (PELNI). The facilities are a bank credit arrangement for the state shipping company.
nd39218dce2.why: BRI is one of Indonesia's largest state-owned banks, and its lending to state enterprises shapes credit exposure in the banking sector.

ndc44d4e760.summary: NZD/USD rose to near 0.5960 as the New Zealand dollar outperformed its peers following positive first-quarter domestic retail sales. The RBA's Hauser was cited as optimistic about robust demand.
ndc44d4e760.why: The New Zealand dollar is a commodity-linked currency whose moves reflect domestic economic data and the central bank's rate outlook.

n52b1325a76.summary: Russia has become Poland's main cucumber supplier, citing quality, competitive prices and efficient logistics. The report notes this despite tense political relations between the two countries.
n52b1325a76.why: Food import dependence and trade flows between neighbouring economies affect agricultural markets and supply-chain costs.
